rules: One classification per register office_id, including the two historical Gozo Civic Council offices.
Draft tier labels are unchanged: 204 municipal / 8 regional / 2 national / 1 other.
Local councils, mayors, and deputy mayors are municipal. Mayors and deputies are conditional first-preference or council election, not separate popular ballots.
Six current regional presidencies and the historical Gozo Civic Council and its president are regional.
The House and the indirect President are national. The EP delegation is other.
Per-office review_status stays needs_review. File status is approved with Malta_Research_Gaps gates left open.
The successor crosswalk stays empty. No popular presidential ballot, STV transfer paper, or House division tally is invented.
notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-22 America/Edmonton with the Malta_Research_Gaps gates left open. No popular presidential or mayor ballot, STV transfer paper, or missing House division tally was added. The successor crosswalk stays empty. Four 2021 regional sole nominees stay nominations.

approval.notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-22 Prompt AP with Malta_Research_Gaps gates left open. 213 current + 2 historical offices (215); 223 events; 4084 result rows and 64204 STV count observations in the full pack. Draft tiers 204 municipal / 8 regional / 2 national / 1 other. Standalone direct-executive offices 0. President is indirect House resolution. Mayors and deputy mayors are conditional first-preference or council election. Successor crosswalk stays empty. No popular presidential or mayor ballot, STV transfer paper, or House division tally was invented. Per-office review_status stays needs_review. stv-counts.json, results.json, and sources omitted from this slim land.
